mechanism: Fuse a locally written positive-width base and a following U+0300..036F zero-width mark only when another printable scalar follows. Reuse exact singleton CellExtra in destination, otherwise existing cache. No Cell representation, UTF8 policy, parser, reader or unsafe change.
correctness: literal fused mark overwrite COW and style oracle

engine.primary: Unicode median paired CPU rate >=1.02, wins>losses, six-workload Holm p<.05; all six point medians >=.98
engine.stop: Exactly 12 pairs, no pilot/retry/pooling/rescue. On failed correctness no timing; on failed screen restore. Surviving screen still needs fresh same-build PTY and missing metrics.
